description: This file implements the base class for AI services within the Pipecat framework, providing core functionalities such as model management, settings update, session handling, and frame processing lifecycle methods. It defines the AIService class, which inherits from FrameProcessor, and includes methods for starting, stopping, canceling, and processing frames, as well as updating settings and handling external dependencies.

classes.name: AIService
classes.description: A base class providing foundational functionalities for AI services, enabling model management, settings updates, and frame lifecycle processing.

methods.name: set_model_name(self, model: str)
methods.description: Sets the AI model name and updates metrics accordingly.

methods.name: start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Placeholder method to initialize AI service at start; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Placeholder method for cleanup at stopping; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Placeholder method to handle cancellation logic; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: _update_settings(self, settings: Mapping[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates the service's settings and session properties based on provided settings mapping, with special handling for session-related keys.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Automatically manages frame types such as StartFrame, EndFrame, and CancelFrame, invoking corresponding lifecycle methods.

methods.name: process_generator(self, generator: AsyncGenerator[Frame | None, None])
methods.description: Processes frames asynchronously from a generator, handling error frames separately and pushing frames to the processing pipeline.
